reason: Independent exact-scope review of Media authorization PR #180 proved that trusted main has unknownPathFailsClosed=true and ten future Media supply-chain/runtime/Element UI paths are not recognized by the base-owned WP0 routing policy. A second independent cross-workline review also proved that merely authorizing wp0-routing-policy.json as a changed path does not mechanically constrain the semantic mutation inside that file. Candidate-owned routing edits and prose-only restrictions are forbidden. This prerequisite therefore authorizes an exact route bootstrap plus the generic delegated route-policy mutation guard; it creates no Media product authority and does not widen the frozen 23-path Media implementation scope.

digestCanonicalization.pathNormalization: Exact normalized repository-relative paths; unique; JavaScript default Array.prototype.sort().
digestCanonicalization.canonicalText: Join sorted unique paths with LF and append one trailing LF.

evidence.auditMethod: Static exact-path classification against trusted-main productExactPaths/productPrefixes/productDocumentation rules; causal RED is required in the first implementation commit before routing policy mutation.
evidence.genericMutationGuardFinding: A delegated route-bootstrap authorization that only scopes the changed filename wp0-routing-policy.json does not by itself prove that the candidate changed only the authorized productExactPaths additions. A permanent branch-policy semantic guard is required.

candidatePreservation.postBootstrapRule: After route-bootstrap implementation merges to main, main must be merged normally into PR #180, its base receipt must be fresh-main resealed by a descendant commit, and the effective Media implementation diff/path digest must remain exact before authorization merge.

parallelRouteReconciliation.rule: These are shared governance composition roots, not serialization locks. Whichever route-bootstrap root fix ordinary-merges first becomes fresh main. Any later Media route implementation must ordinary-forward reconcile that main, preserve the already-effective generic guard and other exact route literals, add only Media's authorized ten literals, and re-seal its effective exact diff without rebase, force, amend or squash.

After implementation each of the ten exact Media bootstrap paths selects PRODUCT_WP0.

The generic delegated implementation guard compares routing-policy semantics to the authorization merge base and permits only adding that authorization's exact bootstrapPaths/futureProductBootstrapPaths to productExactPaths; every other routing-policy mutation is RED.
The root fix adds only the ten exact Media literals to productExactPaths and does not add config/, integration/, runtime/, third_party/ or any other broad product prefix.

The final Media route-bootstrap changed-path set remains exactly four paths with SHA-256 1d13d92c3be9ce5c5b22bf51553ec5a2390240b85c31b3b5990dda4eb071873c unless a prior ordinary merge makes one or more generic-guard paths byte-identical to fresh main, in which case the effective diff must be re-sealed without reauthorizing new paths.
